contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING/AGENTS steering files exist; README is standard Vite. Match existing code style: functional components, named exports for sections/ui (e.g. `export function Hero`), default export for pages, Tailwind utility classes keyed to the semantic color names (bg-accent, text-foreground, border-border, etc.), and the Reveal/Button/MagneticButton primitives. Commit locally on the branch; never push.
key_patterns: Colors are referenced in TWO ways: (1) Tailwind utility classes using semantic keys (bg-accent, text-accent, bg-surface, border-border, accent-soft, accent-glow) defined in tailwind.config.js, and (2) CSS custom properties in src/index.css :root.
